sentence_example: Die Wäsche muss im Garten trocknen.
sentence_example_translation_en: The laundry needs to dry in the garden.
sentence_synonym: Die Wäsche muss im Garten abtrocknen.
typical_collocations: Wäsche trocknen; Tränen trocknen; an der Luft trocknen
usage_comments_en: Can be used transitively (to dry something, e.g., 'die Wäsche trocknen') or intransitively (to become dry, e.g., 'die Wäsche trocknet'). In spoken language, 'abtrocknen' is often used for dishes or oneself, while 'austrocknen' means to dry out completely.

word_translation_en: to dry; to wipe dry (dishes, hands)
sentence_example: Nach dem Spülen muss man das Geschirr gründlich abtrocknen.
sentence_example_translation_en: After washing up, one has to dry the dishes thoroughly.
sentence_example_translation_ru: После мытья посуду нужно тщательно вытереть насухо.
sentence_synonym: Nach dem Spülen muss man das Geschirr sorgfältig trockenreiben.
typical_collocations: Geschirr abtrocknen; sich die Hände abtrocknen; das Gesicht abtrocknen
usage_comments_en: Separable verb (trocknet ab, trocknete ab, hat abgetrocknet). Refers specifically to wiping liquid off surfaces or skin with a towel or cloth. Reflexive: 'sich abtrocknen'.

word_translation_en: to dry up; to dry off (surface moisture)
sentence_example: Sobald die Pfützen aufgetrocknet sind, können wir draußen spielen.
sentence_example_translation_en: As soon as the puddles have dried up, we can play outside.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Как только лужи просохнут, мы сможем поиграть на улице.
sentence_synonym: Sobald die Pfützen abgetrocknet sind, können wir draußen spielen.
typical_collocations: die Pfützen trocknen auf; die Feuchtigkeit trocknet auf
usage_comments_en: Separable verb taking sein (ist aufgetrocknet). Mostly intransitive, describing surface dampness vanishing through evaporation.

word_translation_en: to start to dry; to dry partially on the surface
sentence_example: Lass die erste Lackschicht kurz antrocknen, bevor du weitermalst.
sentence_example_translation_en: Let the first coat of paint dry slightly before continuing to paint.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Дай первому слою лака слегка подсохнуть, прежде чем красить дальше.
sentence_synonym: Lass die erste Farbschicht kurz anziehen, ehe du weitermalst.
typical_collocations: Farbe antrocknen lassen; Schlamm antrocknen lassen
usage_comments_en: Separable verb taking sein (ist angetrocknet). Describes an incipient or surface-level drying process (e.g. paint, clay, mud) without being completely dry.

word_translation_en: to dry out; to desiccate; to drain
sentence_example: Wegen der Hitze droht der See komplett auszutrocknen.
sentence_example_translation_en: Due to the heat, the lake is threatening to dry out completely.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Из-за жары озеро рискует полностью пересохнуть.
sentence_synonym: Wegen der Hitze droht der See völlig zu versiegen.
typical_collocations: ein Fluss trocknet aus; der Boden trocknet aus; die Kehle austrocknen
usage_comments_en: Can be intransitive (sein: a lake dries out) or transitive (haben: to dry something out). Often used for bodies of water, soil, or metaphorical wells of inspiration.

word_translation_en: to dry thoroughly; to cure completely
sentence_example: Die Farbe muss über Nacht gut durchtrocknen.
sentence_example_translation_en: The paint needs to dry thoroughly overnight.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Краска должна хорошо просохнуть за ночь.
sentence_synonym: Die Farbe muss über Nacht ganz abtrocknen.
typical_collocations: vollständig durchtrocknen; gut durchtrocknen lassen; der Putz trocknet durch
usage_comments_en: Takes 'sein' as an intransitive verb and 'haben' when used transitively. Often used for materials like paint, varnish, wood, or plaster indicating drying to the core.

word_translation_en: to dry up; to shrivel; to cake onto
sentence_example: Die Tinte in der Patrone ist leider eingetrocknet.
sentence_example_translation_en: Unfortunately, the ink in the cartridge has dried up.
sentence_example_translation_ru: К сожалению, чернила в картридже засохли.
sentence_synonym: Die Tinte in der Patrone ist leider unbrauchbar geworden.
typical_collocations: die Tinte ist eingetrocknet; eingetrocknete Flecken; eingetrockneter Schlamm
usage_comments_en: Intransitive (forms perfect with 'sein'). Refers to liquids or pasty substances losing moisture and becoming solid, crusty, or unusable.

word_translation_en: to dry fast; to stick by drying
sentence_example: Der Schmutz ist am Schuh festgetrocknet.
sentence_example_translation_en: The dirt has dried and stuck firmly to the shoe.
sentence_synonym: Der Schmutz ist am Schuh angetrocknet.
usage_comments_en: Intransitive (takes 'sein'). Describes a substance drying to the point where it becomes stuck tightly to a surface.

word_translation_en: to wither; to dry up and die
sentence_example: Ohne regelmäßiges Gießen vertrocknen die Blumen schnell.
sentence_example_translation_en: Without regular watering, the flowers wither quickly.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Без регулярного полива цветы быстро засыхают.
sentence_synonym: Ohne regelmäßiges Gießen verdorren die Blumen schnell.
typical_collocations: Pflanzen vertrocknen; die Ernte vertrocknet; vor Durst vertrocknen
usage_comments_en: Intransitive (takes 'sein'). Specifically implies suffering damage or death due to lack of water; commonly used for plants, grass, or colloquially exaggerated for humans being thirsty.

word_translation_en: to wipe dry; to disappear by drying
sentence_example: Er trocknete die Tränen mit einem Taschentuch weg.
sentence_example_translation_en: He wiped the tears away with a handkerchief.
sentence_synonym: Er wischte die Tränen mit einem Taschentuch ab.
usage_comments_en: Transitive verb (takes 'haben'). Often used in the context of removing small amounts of moisture like tears or spills by drying/wiping.
